title: SS27 Boys' Knit Shape and Fit Outlook
summary: Boys' knit shapes: oversized tees, piqué and mesh polos, track sets, rash guards and swim shorts with liners.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Cozmo showed striped T-shirts and coordinated sets forming a total look, for newborns to 14 years<sup>[1]</sup>
- Sport influence was presented "through a more refined, creative lens"; denim felt "stronger and more diverse than in recent seasons"<sup>[2]</sup>
- Teeter Totter showed UPF50+ swim and sportswear, backpacks and ultra-light, sand-free beach towels<sup>[1]</sup>
- Fatamadrina lists relaxed shapes, dungarees, oversized T-shirts, pleated dresses and lightweight jackets as SS27 silhouettes<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Shapes and fit
sections.body:
- **Oversized tee:** dropped shoulder.
- **Polo:** straight fit, piqué or mesh.
- **Track set:** zip jacket and shorts.
- **Rash guard and swim short.**
- **Stripe set.**

design_implications:
- Flat seams on rash guards.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Tees and polos are reorder lines.
